# Development-only. Nothing here is needed to build or view the site.
#
# The site itself is generated by tools/sitegen/sitegen.py with the standard
# library alone, and ships no runtime dependency.
#
# python-docx is required by exactly one gate — tools/sitegen/docx_regression.py,
# the Phase 1.7 check that the five downloadable .docx files are unchanged.
# Without it that gate cannot run; every other check still does.
#
# Install with:  python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python-docx>=1.1.0
